reason: Subject reads as a refactor/extraction PR: moving hint-handling code into `pkg/util/hint`. Although it touches many planner/executor files, the metadata does not suggest a change to core optimizer, executor, session, KV, or parser semantics; it looks more like dependency reshaping and call-site rewiring around existing hint logic. Given the stricter second-stage bar, this is more consistent with a broad but mostly mechanical cleanup than a PR that obviously merits a 20-40 minute Blocker/High bug hunt.
